About

Sumaiyya
Ali

At my core, I'm a researcher who uses design to speak human. My work sits at the intersection of digital systems and social behavior, exploring how the tools we build ultimately build us.

My design philosophy was truly forged on the ground in Pakistan, where I founded an NGO to support underserved communities. That experience stripped away the "fluff" of design and taught me to solve problems where resources are thin but the human impact is massive.

Today, I bring that same grit and insight to every complex technical challenge I tackle.

Case Studies
01
Nest
Product Design  ·  UX/UI  ·  Concept + System Design  ·  Read time: 5 min

A family-centered app and AR system designed to strengthen emotional connection through daily interactions and shared experiences.

The Problem

Families are constantly in touch but rarely truly connected. Most interactions revolve around logistics, not emotion. While digital tools support coordination, they fail to create meaningful shared experiences.

Over time, this leads to distance within households, especially across generations with different communication styles. Families lack simple, engaging ways to build emotional connection in everyday life.

The Goal

  • Encourage small, consistent moments of connection
  • Create shared experiences through play and interaction
  • Bridge generational gaps in a natural way

The goal is to make connection effortless, not intentional.

03
Scrollytelling
Data Architecture
Full-Stack Developer & Data Analyst

Transformed a research study on the psychological impacts of digital isolation into an interactive, browser-based narrative experience.

↗ View Live Project
From Raw Research to Production-Ready Solution
Technical Implementation & System Design
Process

The Challenge

Humanizing complex data correlation. I bridged the gap between raw correlation matrices (Attachment Styles vs. Social Media Frequency) and a compelling user narrative — making invisible psychological data tangible and engaging.

Tech Stack

  • HTML5, Tailwind CSS, and React
  • Chart.js for real-time data rendering
  • Native IntersectionObserver API for scroll-triggered logic
  • Deployed via GitHub Pages

Full-Stack  ·  Hardware Prototyping  ·  AI/CV  ·  Systems Design

An AI-powered ecosystem for circular food systems — reducing food waste in Singapore's hawker centers through real-time feedback and behavioral nudges.

Research — Field Interviews

We interviewed 21 consumers, 10 hawker stall vendors, and 3 cleaning staff at hawker centers in Maxwell, Chinatown, Tampines, Bedok, Pasir Ris and SUTD.
